thread:
maya: Heads up — just helped a user who hit a 402 on their very first SDK call after following the quickstart. They were blocked and confused.

devon: Oof. Is this a trial-expired case or fresh workspace with no payment method?

maya: Fresh workspace. Error from the browser: `Error: Request failed with status code 402`. Server proxy shows payload: 
```json
{"status":402,"error":"workspace billing_required","request_id":"req_1234abcd"}
```

samir: That suggests the workspace state is `billing_required`. Does the JS SDK surface a clear explanation or link?

maya: Not today — it retries once, then throws a generic error. The user couldn't tell what to do next.

devon: Can we make the SDK treat 402 as a non-retriable onboarding error and include a `help_url` pointing to the org billing page? e.g. `https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/<org>/billing`

ella: I'll update the quickstart README with a short troubleshooting section: how to verify workspace billing and what to check in local dev (env vars, proxy headers). Also include the exact error snippet so support can triage faster.

samir: Small gotcha I noticed: when running the Next sample with `vercel dev` the `x-workspace-id` header gets dropped by the dev proxy. That can cause requests to land on a different workspace and trigger billing gates unexpectedly. We should add a dev-mode warning in the sample server: if `x-workspace-id` missing, log a clear message.

maya: Repro steps I used: clone `redwood-starter`, `yarn`, set `REDWOOD_KEY`, run `yarn dev`, open incognito, click "Run demo". First call 402.

devon: Action items:
- SDK: map 402 -> OnboardingBillingError with `help_url` and make it non-retriable (samir to PR, 2d).
- Samples: emit a console warning when workspace header missing and update README with `vercel dev` note (ella, 1d).
- Docs: add a short troubleshooting snippet for first-call 402 and link to billing docs (maya, 1d).

onboard-bot: Suggested automated message for users who hit 402: "It looks like your organization needs to complete billing setup. See https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/billing for next steps." :wave:

maya: Also filing a support ticket and attaching this thread + logs. If the user still can't proceed after the docs, we can send a billing invite flow from the console.

devon: Thanks. Samir, please include a Sentry breadcrumb so these errors are grouped and show the `workspace_id` and `request_id` but avoid logging any secret keys.

samir: On it. I'll open the SDK PR and include test for 402 behavior.

ella: I'll push the README patch and sample warning today.

maya: Awesome, thanks everyone. This should cut down on confused first-time users. :thumbsup:
